profile.headline: Natural Born US Citizen without dual citizenship - TechnicalLead/Senior Software Developer at U.S. Bank
profile.summary:
I am a US Citizen with over 15 years of Java Enterprise development experience with a large variety of business verticals in start-ups, midlevel companies, Fortune 500 and Fortune 50 companies through direct engagements, contracts, and as a member of professional services.  I have gained experience using many different technologies and technology stacks across a wide variety of roles including developer, lead, architect, dev manager, and director.

CORE COMPETENCIES: Enterprise Architecture and Development ∙ Microservices Architecture and Development ∙ Cloud Solutions and Development ∙ Mobile/IOS/Android Application Development ∙ Web Application Development ∙ Emerging Technologies/Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence

LANGUAGES: Java, Python, C#, SQL, Javascript, Typescript, C/C++, Groovy

SOFTWARE: OS(Windows/Linux/iOS/UNIX), Jira, GIT, Tomcat, Weblogic, JBoss, InteliJ, VS Code, Apache, Eclipse, JProbe, Oracle, MS SQL Server, MySQL, DB2, Websphere, IIS, SAP BO, OBIEE, Jenkins, Elasticsearch, ELK, and Various Legacy Systems

ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: AI Component Architecture, Neural Net/Deep Learning, Biometrics(Facial, Speech, & Fingerprint Recognition), Text Categorization, Expert Systems

CERTIFICATIONS - Agile/Scrum, BSCS, CMM, WebLogic, Rational Rose & RUP, AWS

NOTABLE FORTUNE 500 EXPERIENCE - US Bank, Bank of America, Capital One, Fidelity, Wachovia, TIAA Financial Services, Riggs Bank/US Treasury, Bellsouth, Verizon, AT&T, TMobile, Tracfone, Nasdaq, S&P 500, CSFB Investor Trading, Fedex, Walmart, Kroger, Levi Strauss, AstraZeneca, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Delta, US Airlines, Oracle, Papa Johns, Coca-Cola, Toyota, Ticketmaster and CNN
